description: Every part Unstocked lists for a bike, optionally for one model year or category. Each part has an id (for make_build_link), category, brand, tier, typical price, fitment note, flags (track-only, wants-tune) and whether it is listed for the model year. Also returns stock equipment and things to know before buying.

query.description: Words in the part or brand name, e.g. "akrapovic" or "slip-on".

year.description: Model year. With it, parts not listed for that year are left out.

name: get_parts
title: Get parts for a bike
